winner_analysis.headline: Why Logistic Regression Outperforms Random Forest & KNN on This Dataset

points.title: Smooth Linear Clinical Risk Relationship
points.detail: In this 4,000-row clinical dataset, cardiovascular risk rises smoothly and additively with standardized biomarkers (max heart rate, age, ST depression, chest pain type, exercise-induced angina, smoking, HbA1c, HDL). Logistic Regression learns this smooth log-odds boundary directly, whereas Random Forest approximates diagonal boundaries using axis-aligned step splits.

points.title: Higher Sensitivity (Recall) & ROC-AUC on Test Data
points.detail: On the 600-patient held-out test set, Logistic Regression achieves 96.1% ROC-AUC, 89.7% accuracy, and 89.0% recall on Heart Disease cases — outperforming Random Forest (95.5% ROC-AUC, 86.8% recall) and KNN (92.5% ROC-AUC, 56.0% recall).

points.title: Why KNN Trails Behind
points.detail: After One-Hot Encoding categorical features, the feature space has 25+ dimensions. Distance-based KNN suffers from the curse of dimensionality, causing lower recall (56.0%) compared to parametric and ensemble methods.

points.title: Well-Calibrated Probabilities & Interpretability
points.detail: Logistic Regression produces naturally calibrated risk percentages (0%–100%) and clear positive/negative feature weights (coefficients), which is ideal for medical screening.
